description: This PHP source file defines a controller class 'GenericRestController' within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management System. The class provides REST API endpoint handling, including initialization, request handling (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE), validation, and response formatting for resource endpoints. It manages dynamic API endpoint instantiation, request type differentiation, and error handling related to endpoint types.

classes.name: GenericRestController
classes.description: A REST controller class that handles CRUD operations for a REST API endpoint, supporting dynamic endpoint instantiation, validation, and response management within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the API endpoint based on request attributes, validating class existence and type.

methods.name: handleGetRequest
methods.description: Handles GET requests, differentiating between retrieval of a single resource or a collection.

methods.name: initGetValidationRule
methods.description: Sets the validation rules for GET requests based on whether it's a get-one or get-all request.

methods.name: handlePostRequest
methods.description: Handles POST requests for creating new resources.

methods.name: initPostValidationRule
methods.description: Sets validation rules for POST requests.

methods.name: handlePutRequest
methods.description: Handles PUT requests for updating existing resources.

methods.name: initPutValidationRule
methods.description: Sets validation rules for PUT requests.

methods.name: handleDeleteRequest
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests for removing resources.

methods.name: initDeleteValidationRule
methods.description: Sets validation rules for DELETE requests.

methods.name: getNotInstanceOfException
methods.description: Generates an exception indicating an endpoint is not of the expected type.

methods.name: isGetOneRequest
methods.description: Determines if the current request is a 'get one' or 'get all' operation.

methods.name: getPreparedResponseParamsFromResult
methods.description: Prepares response parameters from the endpoint result, including normalization and meta-information.
